C1186.title: SolarWinds Orion Software Update Backdoor Incident
C1186.summary: In December 2020, a backdoor was implanted into the software update package for SolarWinds' Orion platform, compromising thousands of institutional customers, including U.S. government agencies such as the National Security Agency and major enterprises.
